proof_body:
by
  intro r t
  have h0 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => ((r : ℝ) * Real.exp t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) (Real.exp ((r : ℝ) * Real.exp t)) := by
    have := NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp ((r : ℝ) * Real.exp t)
    rwa [← Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ] at this
  have h1 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-(r : ℝ)) * (r : ℝ) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * (n : ℝ))) (Real.exp ((r : ℝ) * (Real.exp t - 1))) := by
    have := h0.mul_left (Real.exp (-(r : ℝ)))
    have hv : Real.exp ((r : ℝ) * (Real.exp t - 1)) = Real.exp (-(r : ℝ)) * Real.exp ((r : ℝ) * Real.exp t) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    rw [hv]
    refine Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f : ℕ → ℝ => HasSum f _) (funext fun n => ?_)) this
    rw [mul_comm t, Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_pow]
    ring
  have hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (t * (n : ℝ))) (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) := by
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.integrable_poissonMeasure_iff]
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using h1.summable
  refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
  have h2 := ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_integral_poissonMeasure hint
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h2
  exact h2.unique h1
target_source: ∀ (r : NNReal) (t : ℝ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (t * (n : ℝ))) (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) ∧ ProbabilityTheory.mgf (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) t = Real.exp ((r : ℝ) * (Real.exp t - 1))
